headline.title: A French bank is robbed through its supplier
headline.quip: About €100 million left the bank without anyone touching a vault. Customers lose nothing, the bank says, except the app for a while.
headline.summary: Attackers stole about €100 million from Crédit Mutuel Arkéa through a supplier, according to the bank; Le Télégramme had reported €118 million. Some transactions were suspended, transfers were delayed and the app was unavailable. The bank says customers face no losses.

also.title: Ransomware hits all 66 Queens Public Library branches
also.summary: Ransomware took down computers, checkout machines, Wi-Fi and the app across all 66 Queens Public Library branches, which stayed open.

reasons: Backfilled during setup and reviewed by the owner.
